segments.sn48.9:1.5: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ –
segments.sn48.9:1.6: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saddhindriyaṃ.
segments.sn48.9:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, vīriyindriyaṃ.
segments.sn48.9:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, satindriyaṃ.
segments.sn48.9:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako vossaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassa ekaggataṃ – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, samādhindriyaṃ.
segments.sn48.9:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya, sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, paññindriyaṃ.

lines: 479-480. Navame satinepakkenāti ettha nipakassa bhāvo nepakkaṃ, paññāyetaṃ nāmaṃ.
Sā ca paññāsampayuttāva balavatī hoti, na vippayuttāti paññāsampayuttasatiṃ dassento evamāha.
Cirakatanti cirakālaṃ kataṃ dānaṃ vā sīlaṃ vā uposathakammaṃ vā.
Cirabhāsitanti “asukasmiṃ ṭhāne asukaṃ nāma bhāsitan”ti evaṃ cirakāle bhāsitaṃ.
Imasmiṃ sutte saddhāsatipaññindriyāni pubbabhāgāni, vīriyindriyaṃ missakaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ nibbattitalokuttarameva kathitaṃ.
Nipāyati saṃkilesadhamme visoseti nikkhāmetīti nipako, thiratikkhasatipuggalo, tassa bhāvo nepakkanti satiyāpi nepakkabhāvo yujjateva.
Evañhi “satinepakkenā”ti idaṃ vacanaṃ samatthitaṃ hoti, satiyā ca nepakkenāti evaṃ vuccamānena satiniddeso nāma kato hotiyeva.
Asukaṃ nāma suttaṃ vā kammaṭṭhānaṃ vā me bhāsitanti.
Gacchantiyāti saṅkhārānaṃ udayañca vayañca udayabbayaṃ gacchantiyā bujjhantiyā.
Saddhāsatipaññindriyāni pubbabhāgāni “itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ, cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā, udayatthagāminiyā paññāyā”ti ca vuttattā.
“Āraddhavīriyo viharati, so anuppannānan”tiādinā ca vuttattā vīriyindriyaṃ missakaṃ.
